title: Hazel and the Extraction
author: Hazel Hartwell
blurb: Sable Yarrow, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
